text:
[Council File 26-1170]
Motion (Padilla - Park) relative to the impacts of the Mayor’s proposed Capital Infrastructure Plan and the Bureau of Engineering’s proposed capital project intake process.
(This item is referred to the Arts, Parks, and City Facilities Committee, Budget and Finance Committee, and Public Works Committee. The Public Works Committee approved the item on August 26, 2026.)
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted

outcome.text: Arts, Parks, and City Facilities Committee concurred with the Public Works Committee's action of August 26, 2026 to approve the Motion dated August 21, 2026 (Sep 16, 2026)
